prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1300; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. Examination on initial visit showed localized swelling, tenderness, and reduced grip strength in the affected wrist. Radiographs confirmed a distal radius fracture, and the imaging findings and exam together clearly establish the injury. The patient reports no prior injury to this wrist or surrounding area, and no earlier records of such a problem were available for review. Over five visits, the patient was managed with immobilization, progressive range-of-motion work, and pain control. Recovery has been somewhat slower than typical for this fracture pattern, and follow-up continues to monitor healing and function. Whether this specific injury resulted entirely from the collision remains to be determined, and the mechanism is still under review. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service without duplication.
